Name: Mod Profiles
Author: Cielestia
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Creates Multiple mod Profiles[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Multiple independent mod profiles.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Create profiles from your existing Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Import existing mod folders.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Browse for folders on Windows.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Back up your active Mods folder before switching.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Restart-based profile switching.[/color][/*]
[/list]


[b][size=4][u]How to Use[/u][/size][/b]
Make sure you always click Prepare Switch before clicking save, and close out game and reopen.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI
GMCM

Manifest.Name: Stardew Valley Mod Profile Manager
Manifest.Description: Create, import, organize, and switch between separate Stardew Valley mod profiles.
Manifest.Author: Cielestia
